key_finding: Edge-hosted double digital twin (learned resource-scheduling twin plus PSO path-planning twin, built from GAN-augmented data with attention-based learning and MA-DDPG) plans UAV parcel deliveries fully autonomously; hardware-in-the-loop Gazebo tests show 63.9% lower distribution latency and 10.9% higher successful-delivery ratio than benchmarks.

V-A (GAN/CNN data augmentation), V-B (multi-modal attention model acquisition, Algorithm 1), V-C (MA-DDPG resource scheduling), V-D (PSO-PP path planning, Algorithm 2). HITL: Abstract ('without the aid of a workforce'); Sec. I ('autonomously adjust distribution paths'); Sec. VI-D ('autonomously associate feasible logistics missions'). Pages 10099-10117.

quotes.text: Our VerDT can assist logistic UAVs in exploring optimal distribution paths through accurate imitation and derivation with two kinds of DT models: a resource scheduling twin model and a path planning twin model.
We deploy multiple UAVs randomly to implement 10 logistics distribution missions (represented by spheres and cubes) which are deployed in three different logistics warehouses.

our algorithm can efficiently integrate the computing resources of one-hop neighbors to implement cooperative computing for obtaining optimal cooperators based on a Multi-agent Deep Determined Policy Gradient (MA-DDPG) architecture.
quotes.section: V-C. Resource Scheduling Twin Model Implementation

quotes.text: we propose a Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO)-based path planning algorithm in the virtual space.
quotes.section: V-D. Path Planning Twin Model Implementation

quotes.text: As an attractive industry application, UAVs-based intelligent logistics has been widely investigated to achieve a fully automated distribution manner without the aid of a workforce.
The DT models can empower UAVs to autonomously adjust distribution paths. It can significantly reduce frequency of model updates for low computing latency.
